evals.prompt: Plan this: migrate the notifications module from polling to websockets across about 8 files.
evals.expected_output: Reads local guidance, states goal, in-scope and out-of-scope, breaks into small phases with exact Files Touched and runnable Verify command, writes to .claude/plans/ or .agents/plans/.
assertions: States goal, in-scope and out-of-scope explicitly
Each phase lists exact file paths (Files Touched) and a runnable Verify command
Scans existing plans first and extends if the same scope plan is 30 days old or newer

evals.prompt: Create a plan to replace our whole billing service with a new implementation.
evals.expected_output: A rewrite adds Phase 0, a prototype gate (1 hour max): implement the first incremental unit, and if more than 3 friction points or more than 2 shims, invoke research-and-decide.
assertions: Adds a Phase 0 prototype gate before implementation phases
Gate is 1 hour max and checks for >3 friction points or >2 temporary shims
Does not skip Phase 0 for perceived urgency

evals.prompt: Rename the variable 'cnt' to 'count' in utils.py, one occurrence.
evals.expected_output: Two files or fewer with an obvious edit: just do it, no plan.
assertions: Does not write a plan file
